name: S3 — a coder's reasoning fold is not archived while it is open
why: A worker's trace keeps its newest ten thinking blocks as folds of their own and rolls the rest into 'Older entries'. A block the operator opened rolled in and disappeared mid-run — the same fault the Architect's reasoning had, seen in a coder's trace (19 Nov). An open fold is never archived, in a trace either.
